ES-3b. ES-3a shipped a register on 23 October with no way to put a row in it. This is the thing that was missing, and it is the last piece of the flow.

One finding worth your attention. Nothing in the repository creates can_edit_tenants — not a migration, and not the create_module_permissions command, which only makes the ten can_access_* rows. It exists on Live because somebody made it by hand in the Django admin. A fresh deployment of this application would answer 403 to every edit view for anybody who is not a superuser. Recorded, not fixed — it is its own round.

Send for Signature

Both signers are read off the tenancy, so the joint tenant you split by hand is the one the screen offers. They stay editable: the envelope records who was ASKED, not a view onto the record. Leave the Alivente signer as yourself and Create and sign hands you straight to the signing page.

Choosing the tenancy

Reached from the register, or from a row action on Manage Lease Agreements - which already tells you who has a lease and who has not, and is where you are standing when you notice.
